reviews.text: Excellent practice. Very good, welcoming, and helpful doctors. I highly recommend it.

They are really very very good I also recommend it regarding the price because for the first visit I made a comparison with other vets near me and they were the cheapest and they are also professional and good 💗 …

The doctors are excellent; I've always felt comfortable with them, and I've been able to discuss various issues with them. I trust them with my furry friends, and they give the impression of truly loving animals, as well as being incredibly kind.
Thank you.
Dr. Guelfi is a truly invaluable professional.
All the staff are very competent, I really recommend it!
For years, they've been the go-to for my extended family of dogs and cats. The girls (all of them) are incredibly professional, gentle, precise, and kind, both with animals and humans.
I brought my Alcor very kind and knowledgeable people

The doctors at the practice are excellent and very caring with animals. I brought them an 8-year-old female Amstaff, who was quite impetuous and wary but would let them do anything, and my kittens, who are all in excellent health and adore them. You can pay by card, and they do blood and urine tests on the spot if necessary, as they are very thorough. Highly recommended.
Excellent welcome. We (the cat and I) arrived for an emergency. They handled me (anxious) and the cat (its first time outside) admirably. Quick tests. Effective advice.
Here you'll find: professionalism, expertise, attention, passion, and sensitivity. My three furry friends recommend it 🥰...and I do too ♥️ …
Dr. Monica is fantastic. My cats are always so happy to see her.
